# Appendix C. Normative References

- 3GPP TS 36.213: Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA); Physical layer procedures.
- 3GPP TS 38.213: NR; Physical layer procedures for control.
- 3GPP TS 23.285: Architecture enhancements for V2X services.
- IEEE 802.11-2020: Wireless LAN Medium Access Control and Physical Layer Specifications.
- IEEE 802.11bd-2022: Enhancements for next-generation V2X.
- IEEE 802.3bp: 1000BASE-T1 Physical Layer.
- IEEE 1609.2-2022: Security Services for Applications and Management Messages.
- IEEE 1609.2.1-2022: Certificate Management Interfaces for End Entities.
- ETSI EN 302 636-4: GeoNetworking.
- ETSI EN 302 636-5: Transport protocols; Part 5: Basic Transport Protocol.
- ETSI EN 302 571: Radiocommunications equipment operating in the 5 855 MHz to 5 925 MHz range.
- ETSI TS 103 097 v2.1.1: Security header and certificate formats.
- ETSI TS 102 940: Communications security architecture and security management.
- ETSI TS 102 941: Trust and Privacy Management.
- ETSI TS 103 175: Decentralized Congestion Control Mechanisms for Intelligent Transport Systems.
- ETSI TS 103 324: Collective Perception Service.
- SAE J2735 (2024): V2X Communications Message Set Dictionary.
- SAE J3161: On-board System Requirements for LTE V2X V2V Safety Communications.
- ISO 11898-1:2024: Controller Area Network; Part 1: Data link layer and physical signalling.
- ISO 13400: Diagnostic communication over Internet Protocol (DoIP).
- ISO 26262 (all parts): Road vehicles - Functional safety.
- ISO/SAE 22900 series: Modular vehicle communication interface.
- RFC 2119: Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels.
- AUTOSAR Specification of Secure Onboard Communication (SecOC), latest classic release.
- FIPS 140-3: Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules.
